items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: That's what Red Tyler and all of them say.

ctx.x: He knew how and he taught Smiley a whole lot and I did too. Fields taught Smiley something. I did too. That's interesting. And somebody said he had been playing about 20 years or more and he learned more and a little while he played with me than he had in all the years he had been playing. Well, your band was always the favorite band of New Orleans, wasn't it? I don't know. In their 50s and everything. I don't know. That's what I hear. That's what Red Tyler and all of them say.
